description:
Today marks a defining moment in our mission to democratise real estate investing: we're launching Wahed Private Real Estate in the United States! 📣


Real estate represents the world's largest reservoir of wealth, worth $379.7 trillion, yet our community has remained largely excluded from meaningful participation. Structural barriers such as the prevalence of debt and interest has made investing in property generally inaccessible to most Muslims. 


We launched in the UK first, introducing a model for fractional, fully managed, Shariah-compliant real estate investing. Properties funded within hours. Investors began building their portfolios with low minimums. In just a few months, we deployed millions of pounds across properties in the UK.


The US expansion was always part of the vision. Although house prices in the US have surged 54% in the past decade, over 33% of Muslim Americans earn less than $30,000 annually. With rising property prices, but low income and limited Halal financing options, the gap continues to widen for the Muslim diaspora – and so does the need for accessible, Islamically aligned alternatives.


We're addressing a systemic issue that has prevented hundreds of thousands of American Muslims from participating in real estate. With Wahed private real estate, investors can now access fully Shariah-compliant, professionally managed opportunities with as low as $100.

Wahed Wills allows you to easily manage the value of your estate and instantly calculates the suggested Shariah-compliant distribution among your heirs. It also allows you to allocate up to one-third of your estate to a charity or other recipient, via a Wasiyyah. 

With validity in Shariah and English Law, Wahed Wills creates a legal Islamic Will allowing you to protect your own obligations and the rights of your heirs. 

Your documents will be checked by industry experts, ensuring your Will is valid and input correctly, saving you the stress of expensive legal fees. 

And as your circumstances change, Wahed Wills allows you to make unlimited amendments, totally for free for at least three months.
